title: WebToApp Configuration
description: Configuration file for the webtoapp conversion pipeline

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for VS Code autocomplete

name.description: Human-readable app name used in installer UI and window title

source.description: Absolute/relative path to the source project root, or a live website URL (e.g. https://example.com) to wrap

output.description: Absolute or relative path for the converted output project. Defaults to <source>-desktop

targets.description: One or more target platforms to build installers for

mode.description: online: original cloud backend kept as-is (Supabase/Firebase untouched).

icon.description: Path to a 512x512 PNG icon, relative to source root. Auto-detected if omitted.

author.description: Author name written into package.json (required by electron-builder)

type.description: auto: detect and replace. express: always generate local server. none: static only.

port.description: Port for the local Express server

type.description: local: generate JWT auth backed by SQLite users table. none: strip auth (single-user).

defaultAdmin.description: Default admin email for the seeded account

type.description: sqlite: use better-sqlite3. none: no database generation.

migrations.description: Path to Supabase SQL migrations folder, relative to source root

signing.description: Code-signing configuration. Credentials can also be supplied via environment variables (safer for CI).

windows.description: Windows code-signing settings (NSIS installer). Requires OV or EV certificate.

certificatePath.description: Path to a .pfx or .p12 certificate file, relative to source root. Alternatively set WIN_CSC_LINK env var.

certificatePassword.description: Password for the certificate file. Alternatively set WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD env var.

publisherName.description: Publisher name shown in Windows SmartScreen prompt. Must match the CN in your certificate.

signingHashAlgorithms.description: Hash algorithms for signing. sha256 is required for modern Windows.

mac.description: macOS code-signing and notarization settings. Requires Apple Developer Program membership.

certificatePath.description: Path to a .p12 Developer ID Application certificate. Alternatively set CSC_LINK env var.

certificatePassword.description: Certificate password. Alternatively set CSC_KEY_PASSWORD env var.

appleId.description: Apple ID email for notarization. Alternatively set APPLE_ID env var.

appleIdPassword.description: App-specific password for the Apple ID. Generate at appleid.apple.com. Alternatively set APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD env var.

teamId.description: 10-character Apple Developer Team ID. Found in developer.apple.com/account. Alternatively set APPLE_TEAM_ID env var.

updates.description: Auto-update delivery configuration. Powered by electron-updater.

provider.description: github: use GitHub Releases (zero infra). generic: self-hosted HTTP server. s3: AWS/R2 bucket. none: disable auto-updates.

githubOwner.description: GitHub username or org. Required when provider is 'github'.

githubRepo.description: GitHub repository name. Required when provider is 'github'.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of a generic update server. Required when provider is 'generic'.

channel.description: Update channel. Users on 'latest' only see stable releases.

autoDownload.description: Automatically download updates in the background. If false, the app must call window.electronAPI.downloadUpdate().

allowPrerelease.description: Include pre-release versions in update checks.

crashReporting.description: Crash reporting configuration. Errors in the Electron main process are automatically captured.

provider.description: sentry: use Sentry SDK (cloud or self-hosted Glitchtip). none: disable crash reporting.

dsn.description: Sentry DSN. Can also be set via SENTRY_DSN or VITE_SENTRY_DSN env var.

sampleRate.description: Fraction of errors to send (1.0 = all, 0.5 = 50%). Useful for high-volume apps.

environment.description: Environment tag attached to all Sentry events.

ci.description: CI/CD pipeline configuration for cross-platform cloud builds.

provider.description: CI provider to emit workflow files for.

autoEmit.description: Automatically write .github/workflows/build.yml after a successful local build.

githubOwner.description: GitHub username or org that owns the repository.

devTools.description: Open Electron DevTools in the output app

dryRun.description: Log every planned action but skip all file writes and npm installs

resumeFromStage.description: Resume the pipeline from this stage, skipping earlier completed stages

cleanLogs.description: Delete the conversion log file after a successful pipeline run

behaviorParity.description: Controls the post-build behavior parity gate. strict blocks packaging when selected-mode behavior cannot be preserved; warn logs findings; off disables the gate.

mobile.description: Mobile-specific build settings. Only used when 'android' or 'ios' appears in targets.

webDir.description: Directory containing built web assets, relative to the converted project

targetSdkVersion.description: Target Android SDK version. Google Play requires API 35+ for new apps and updates.

buildVariant.description: debug: unsigned APK for testing. release: signed release artifact.

artifactType.description: Release artifact type. Use aab for Google Play.

keystorePath.description: Path to the release keystore file, relative to source root

keystoreAliasPassword.description: Key password for release signing. Defaults to keystorePassword if omitted.

developmentTeam.description: Apple developer team ID for Xcode signing. Found in Xcode → Signing & Capabilities.
